enforcement_status.previous_state: AUD-READ03 / LNX-03 / CRIT-SUB-01: reader roles were read-only by BEHAVIOUR only; no technical isolation was accredited.
enforcement_status.resolution: A reproducible enforcement mechanism now exists in the repository (scripts/readonly_role_sandbox.sh) and is verified by scripts/verify_readonly_sandbox.sh and tests/test_readonly_role_sandbox.py (8 tests). Writes to the repository and to the real HOME fail with EROFS; DNS resolution is unavailable; the sandbox /tmp is ephemeral; no probe survives outside.
enforcement_status.residual_limitation: The harness does not place a subagent process inside the sandbox. Enforcement applies to the shell commands a reader role executes through the wrapper, which is where its filesystem access happens. Two independent readers confirmed the enforcement from inside and one actively attempted eight escape vectors without success. A reader's own non-shell tool calls remain behaviourally, not technically, constrained. Additionally: /dev and /dev/shm inside the sandbox are writable tmpfs; they are ephemeral and invisible outside, so they are not an escape, but the wrapper's header formerly overstated that ALL writes outside the ephemeral /tmp fail. Corrected.
